entries.claim: This dependent same-recension digital comparison supplies the explicitly resolved Latin reading; it does not establish independent transmission or another printed edition.

The approved Benziger page prints Spiritum nobis after the Lauds canticle and the conclusion through Sancti Deus, including eiusdem. Its comma after Christum and absence of a comma after Sancti are retained; the terminal Per omnia and Amen follow the separately bound standard conclusion.

locator.section: Rubricae generales Missalis romani, nn. 505, 511 i, 513 a, 514.

entries.claim: The celebrant says or sings the postcommunion and its conclusion.

The general rule supplies the full Father-addressed conclusion and its terminal Per omnia saecula saeculorum with Amen. Only that terminal continuation is supplied beyond the Vigil Postcommunion printed on p. 218.
